task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Take the shoe with smooth top and grippy sole from the table and carefully drop it on the mat
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架将顶部光滑、鞋底抓地力强的鞋子从桌子上取下，小心地放在垫子上
